name: info-tuscan-groups-001
target: Tuscan-2 square of order11; restricted construction assay, not an unrestricted negative search
scientific_question: Can deleting the identity row and identity symbol from a group-developed Tuscan-2 square of order12, with the proved endpoint normalization and penultimate=v^2 condition, produce a literal Tuscan-2 square of order11 in D12 or Dic3?
source_status: Written immutable standalone source only; not compiled, typechecked, tested or executed. No upstream code imports, network, subprocess, file I/O, dynamic search allocations, randomness or external libraries in the program.
dependency_boundary: The compiler, system C++ headers/SDK and linker are ordinary local toolchain imports. Only compiler binary is currently hash-pinned; this is not a bit-reproducible build claim. Record SDK identity and generated binary SHA after any admitted build.
execution_order: One admitted local compilation, then one binary invocation only if compilation succeeds and pins are recorded. The binary runs controls once, then D12 and Dic3 sequentially, each with a fresh internal120-second deadline. It stops at the first candidate. No retries, seeds, follow-on search, parallel subgroup jobs or old runtime.

resource_ceiling_requested.deadline_allowance: Small fixed controls/settlement overhead; wall intervals are actually reported, not represented as a hard external kill ceiling.

fresh_request_time_resource_observations.scope: Metadata observed for proposal only; parent must refresh at admission, not treat these as launch observations

controls_in_same_binary_before_search: Within-row adjacency mutation preserving row permutation: ADJACENT_REPEAT
Developed Z6 Walecki T1 but non-T2 source: DISTANCE2_REPEAT
Identity, closure, inverse and all associativity triples of C4, D12 and Dic3: VALID
Delete identity row/symbol from positive C4 source: ADJACENT_REPEAT
raw_mathematical_binding: The DFS enumerates starters with first identity, distinct symbols, all nonidentity adjacent right quotients distinct and all two-step right quotients distinct; final endpoint constraint penultimate=v^2 is only the necessary theorem filter. Every completed source is directly checked as a full12x12 Tuscan-2 square, not trusted merely from quotients. The deleted11x11 array is separately checked against full literal row/permutation/linear-distance1/linear-distance2 definition; no Latin-column condition. It is still the author's own checker, not an independent certification route.
graceful_settlement: Internal steady-clock checks every1024 DFS nodes; SIGINT/SIGTERM set a cooperative stop flag. No external timeout wrapper or SIGKILL. Use tool timeout0. Each group prints nodes, examined source starters, elapsed_ms and disposition. UNKNOWN is printed on internal deadline or signal. Exit75 for unknown,2 for control/error,64 for invalid CLI,0 for completed invocation/candidate; exit0 does not itself mean target existence or unrestricted nonexistence.
launch_receipts_required: Parent exact named GO with fresh admission clock/resources and expiry, after source and theorem-boundary review
Fresh exact source/compiler pin check; any mismatch is HOLD, not permission to repair/run
Exclusive absent output directory; no overwrite or deletion
Actual observed start, compile PID/PGID/cwd/argv/exit and binary hash
Actual scientific PID/PGID/cwd/argv, stdout/stderr retained without truncation, actual exit and no-owned-process settlement
Any candidate saved as an immutable literal array, then separate parent/in-harness definition-first checks under their own admission before acceptance
conclusion_boundary: A candidate is a finite positive proposal only until independently checked. A complete enumeration with no candidate is RESTRICTED_MODEL_EXHAUSTED_WITHOUT_FORMAL_CERTIFICATE, never unrestricted T2(11) UNSAT. A deadline is UNKNOWN. The abelian/A4 written route exclusions and nonabelian model filters do not establish that every Tuscan11 square arises by deletion.
